title: Options Action scored in Real time
author: Edgebell
selftext:
Most options scanners flood your screen with raw, unranked sweeps that leave you guessing what actually matters. **EdgeBell** cuts through the noise with a real-time, institutional-grade **100-Point Conviction Score** that instantly grades every order on execution urgency, volume anomaly, and smart-money positioning.  
**How The 100-Point Score Works**  
Every incoming flow alert is evaluated dynamically so you can spot high-conviction institutional setups in seconds:  
 **Sweep Urgency (Up to 25 pts):** Aggressive multi-exchange fills taking liquidity straight off the ask (or bid).  
 **Premium Size & Capital Weight (Up to 20 pts):** Significant institutional capital allocation behind the contract.  
 **Volume vs. Open Interest Anomalies (Up to 15 pts):** Highlights fresh positioning where daily volume aggressively blows past existing OI.  
 **Moneyness & Delta Placement (Up to 15 pts):** High-leverage OTM positioning versus deep ITM institutional hedges.  
 **Buy/Sell Pressure Confirmation (Up to 15 pts):** Directional skew measuring dominant ask-side versus bid-side execution.  
 **Execution Structure & Multi-Trade Velocity (Up to 10 pts):** Rapid repeated hits, ascending fills, and cluster speed confirming active institutional accumulation.  
**Live Scorecard Tiers**  
 **Score 80–100 (HIGH Conviction):** Rare, high-velocity institutional bets—like the **$V 82/100 Bearish Put Sweep** ($185K premium, repeated ascending hits, 93% ask-side, and a massive 43.8x Vol/OI surge).  
 **Score 60–79 (ELEVATED Flow):** Notable smart-money positioning with strong directional alignment—like the **$QQQ 78/100 Bearish Put** ($538K premium, 100% ask-side execution across 72 trades).  
 **Score < 60:** Routine flow and low-urgency order fills filtered out so you only focus on trades with genuine edge.
